gold_sql:
WITH p1 AS (
  SELECT ST_Value(d.rast, 1, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-75.632218 39.738888)',4326)) AS elev
  FROM public.dem_us d
  WHERE ST_Intersects(d.rast, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-75.632218 39.738888)',4326))
  LIMIT 1
),
p2 AS (
  SELECT ST_Value(d.rast, 1, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-71.122317 42.376159)',4326)) AS elev
  FROM public.dem_us d
  WHERE ST_Intersects(d.rast, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-71.122317 42.376159)',4326))
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN p1.elev > p2.elev THEN 'Wilmington & Western Railroad, Wilmington, DE'
    WHEN p2.elev > p1.elev THEN 'Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Studies, MA'
    ELSE 'equal'
  END AS higher_poi,
  p1.elev AS poi1_elevation_m,
  p2.elev AS poi2_elevation_m
FROM p1, p2;

WITH points_of_interest AS (
  SELECT 
    '[3]' AS entity_id,
    'Wilmington & Western Railroad, Wilmington, DE' AS display_name,
    ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(-75.632218, 39.738888), 4326)::geography AS geom
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 
    '[4]' AS entity_id,
    'Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Studies, MA' AS display_name,
    ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(-71.122317, 42.376159), 4326)::geography AS geom
)
SELECT 
  entity_id,
  display_name,
  ROUND(ST_Value(r.rast, ST_Transform(p.geom::geometry, 4326))::numeric, 2) AS elevation
FROM 
  points_of_interest p
  CROSS JOIN public.dem_us r
WHERE 
  ST_Intersects(ST_Transform(p.geom::geometry, 4326), r.rast)
  AND ST_Value(r.rast, ST_Transform(p.geom::geometry, 4326)) IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY 
  elevation DESC;
